title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex’s Final Chapter 35 Preview Teases the Next Villain of Its Major Arc
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex is gearing up for its next installment, Chapter 35, which is scheduled to release on June 19, 2026, and has released another preview teasing what is to come in the next arc. With the chapter only a couple of days away, this serves as the final preview for the upcoming installment.
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Reveals 35 Musical Contributors
content: Anime studio CloverWorks announced on Wednesday the 35 musical acts who are contributing to its original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque). title: Psyren Anime Streams 1st Teaser With Anime Footage
content: Anime distributor REMOW began streaming the second teaser promotional video for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga with subtitles in multiple languages on Wednesday. Although it is the anime's second teaser overall, it is the first one with animated footage.
author: ANN

title: PSYREN Anime Reveals New Trailer Ahead of October Premiere
content: The upcoming PSYREN anime revealed a new trailer ahead of the show’s previously confirmed October 2026 premiere. It was also previously confirmed that it will be a complete adaptation , covering the entirety of the story. Additional information is set to be revealed during REMOW’s Anime Expo 2026 panel on July 4.
author: Anime Corner

title: Attack on Titan Final Season Gets New Key Visual Featuring Mikasa for MAPPA 15th Anniversary
content: MAPPA has revealed the second commemorative key visual for its upcoming 15th anniversary presentation, featuring Attack on Titan with a new illustration created exclusively for the event. The previous visual featured Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: Magic Repo Man Anime Reveals First Trailer, Main Cast Ahead of October 2026 Premiere
content: The upcoming Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest TV anime revealed its first trailer, also confirming its main cast and October 2026 release date.
author: Anime Corner

title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2 Anime's New Video Reveals Theme Songs
content: Kadokawa started streaming the second promotional video for the second television anime season based on Yomu Mishima 's Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai Desu ) light novel series on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: MobSeka: Trapped in a Dating Sim Season 2 New Trailer and Theme Songs Revealed
content: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome is Tough for Mobs ( MobSeka ) Season 2 revealed the second trailer ahead of its July 8 premiere date. Studio ENGI is returning to animate, with Kazura Miura back as the sole director (he co-directed Season 1 with Shinichi Fukumoto).
author: Anime Corner

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Anime by Studio SHAFT Officially Announced
content: Tsumuji Yoshimura’s Just Like Mona Lisa ( Seibetsu “Mona Lisa” no Kimi e ) is officially receiving a TV anime adaptation, with animation by studio SHAFT. The announcement was accompanied by a teaser visual and a special commemorative illustration from Yoshimura.
author: Anime Corner
